value.rationale: The first triangular graph with two nonzero mod-two homology dimensions was a natural unsolved symmetry case. A complete rational top-degree action, distinguishing sign and ordinary permutation representations and ruling out S7-invariant classes, is mathematical information absent from numerical Betti tables. Exact integral freeness in that degree is an independent structural improvement.
